title: Fix background music audibility and update the NO-click prompt sequence (English) while keeping NO always available

requirements.text: Fix the background music experience so the romantic instrumental is reliably audible for users: the play/pause control must successfully start playback after a user click, the volume control must affect the actual playing volume, and the UI must clearly indicate when autoplay is blocked and how to start music.

quotes: 1st of all the i'm not able to here the music

acceptanceCriteria: If browser autoplay is blocked on initial load, an on-screen prompt appears telling the user to click/tap Play to start music.
Clicking the Play control starts audible playback (not muted) using the configured audio source (licensed track if present; otherwise the fallback romantic instrumental).
The volume slider changes the audible volume while music is playing.
Play/Pause control remains visible and correctly reflects the playing state.

requirements.text: Update the NO-click prompt sequence shown after each NO selection to match the user-provided escalation list, but render all prompts in English and display them as the flashing/pulsing message (not as the NO button label).

quotes: Once she clicks on the option NO you will have to flash things like "Are you Sure" "Are you 1000% Sure" "I will always treat you like princess" "Tere saare nakhre uthaunga" "Dher saari shopping karaunga" " Pretty Please" "Maanja cutie" "Ab toh haa kehde" "ek Mauka dede" Flash these options instead of "NO"

acceptanceCriteria: After each NO click, the UI shows the next prompt message in a prominent animated (flashing/pulsing) style near/above the buttons.
The prompt messages are displayed in English equivalents for the provided Hinglish/Hindi phrases.

The prompt sequence includes (in order): "Are you sure?", "Are you 1000% sure?", "I will always treat you like a princess", "I will handle all your tantrums", "I will take you on lots of shopping trips", "Pretty please?", "Say yes, cutie", "Come on, say yes now", "Just give me one chance".
When the sequence is exhausted, the app continues showing a reasonable final English prompt message on subsequent NO clicks.

requirements.text: Continue to visually increase the YES button size on each NO click, but do not remove, hide, disable, or otherwise prevent selecting NO; the user must always be able to select NO.

quotes: every time she selects these options the option yes will keep on growing so that finally she only has the option to say yes and she has no other option of saying no .

acceptanceCriteria: On each NO click, the YES button grows compared to its previous size.
The NO button remains visible and clickable for the entire interaction (no forced YES-only state).
The app still records/submits NO responses when NO is clicked.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text referenced/added by this build request (including the NO-click prompt messages).
Do not remove or disable the ability to choose NO; the user must always be able to select NO without being forced into YES.

Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all backend logic within the single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only create/modify backend/migration.mo if an upgrade requires state migration.
nonGoals: Do not implement any behavior that forces a YES response by removing/hiding/disabling the NO option.
Do not add new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Do not add new backend services, external databases, or real-time messaging.
